assumptions.statement: Released runtime and model match their exact reviewed source and dependency bytes.
assumptions.evidence: Exact local artifact hashes plus pinned-SDK source and build acceptance.
assumptions.scope: Full product; runtime source hashing alone does not prove behavior.

assumptions.statement: The browser correctly implements DOM, typed arrays, WebAssembly, WebCrypto, WebRTC and fetch; optional saved authority and DNS publication additionally require correct IndexedDB CryptoKey structured cloning, transaction commit and Web Locks context-lifetime exclusion.
assumptions.evidence: Browser vendor assurance and independent integration testing, not a Stitch kernel theorem.

assumptions.statement: SHA-256 collision resistance and Ed25519 unforgeability hold for the selected implementations.
External publication is authorized for the exact destination and content. Public relay and signaling are not private.
assumptions.evidence: Explicit user choice and configured destination.
assumptions.scope: Signaling, DNS writes and optional public payload relay.

assumptions.statement: Different holder identifiers are independently failing machines only if separate evidence establishes that fact.
DoH, DNS provider, STUN, signaling and optional relay are reachable and honor their APIs and policies.
assumptions.evidence: Live provider checks and physical multi-network trials.
assumptions.scope: No finite field observation establishes indefinite service.

assumptions.statement: The pointer writer key and recent retained head are obtained independently and protected from rollback.
assumptions.evidence: Independently pinned key and retained observer head, or separately accepted exact recent digest explicitly restored into that same live scope. Both heads and anchor trust remain session-only.

assumptions.statement: A local checked acknowledgment is an assertion by the named holder, not authenticated durable custody.
assumptions.evidence: Receipt authentication, retained bytes and reachability require external evidence.

assumptions.statement: Host transitions are serialized and their budgets, action IDs, trusted head and journal are retained for the required lifetime.
assumptions.evidence: Application adapter review and crash/concurrency tests.
assumptions.scope: Pure state transitions do not provide durable atomic storage.

assumptions.statement: Monotonic elapsed time does not regress; pointer wall-clock error is within a separately accepted bound.
assumptions.evidence: Clock integration tests and independent clock policy.
assumptions.scope: Freshness, budgets and leases; no global time oracle.

assumptions.statement: v86, BIOS, guest image and 9p/Ethernet bridge obey their reviewed isolation and resource contracts.
assumptions.evidence: Exact binary inventory, upstream provenance, security review and VM integration tests.
assumptions.scope: Arbitrary guest effects are not ring-program semantics.

preconditions: guarded local 9p allocation installed before run

Browser scheduling and host VM behavior are assumptions, not guest isolation or ring-work metering.

preconditions: IndexedDB and CryptoKey structured cloning available

capabilities.proofScope: Origin-local retention only; no backup, cross-device durability, automatic key rotation or provider exactly-once guarantee.

inputs: exact database zone name and authority scope
failures: owner context termination leaves journal unknown

architecture.name: Stitch operator
architecture.text: Chooses mesh participation, public disclosure, trusted pointer authority, DNS writes and VM actions.

architecture.name: Conditional recovery and honest assurance
architecture.text: Recover exact bytes and replay pure jobs without confusing untrusted host observations, network availability or arbitrary VM effects with proved domain rules.

architecture.name: Stitch reader
architecture.text: Learns the object, fragment, custody, replay and authority protocol before taking part.

architecture.name: Stitch reviewer
architecture.text: Reviews exact-source evidence, host assumptions, vendor provenance and qualification gaps.

architecture.name: Stitch systemIntegrator
architecture.text: Embeds or extends the protocol without bypassing resource, trust or effect admission.

architecture.name: security
architecture.text: Keep independently accepted authority, exact commitments, explicit disclosure and ambiguous effects distinct.

architecture.name: transparency
architecture.text: Trace every product statement to its source and evidence scope; do not promote observations into certification.

architecture.name: usability
architecture.text: Present the concept and protocol with readable explanations, scalable visuals, keyboard-accessible interaction and explicit evidence states.
